review_evidence: README gives the project goal of proving Craig interpolation for propositional dynamic logic.
Inspection found 68 Lean files and over 1,600 declaration-shaped items spanning vocabulary, model graphs, tableau constructions, completeness, interpolation, and related bimodal logic.
Files under Unused are not generated copies and may preserve distinct formal lemmas/approaches; path-name status alone is insufficient for lossless exclusion.
summary: Retain lean4-pdl including Bml, Pdl, and Unused: the repository is a large modal/dynamic-logic formalization and even exploratory modules contain independently searchable statements.
